d:
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ka sasural men huaa shandar svagat, sas aasha devi ne lutaya khub pyara.
Grih pravesh ki rasm ke dauran aasha devi ne bahu shivangi ka paranprik andaj men kiya svagta.
Dekhie shivangi ke grih pravesh ka khubsurat vidiyo aur parivar ke is khas pal ki jhalka.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
